strings.name: James Gorman
strings.role: Disney chairman and former Morgan Stanley CEO
strings.summary: Australian-born James Gorman led Morgan Stanley and expanded its wealth management business. He stepped down as CEO at the end of 2023, served as executive chairman in 2024 and became chairman emeritus in 2025. That year he also became Disney chairman, helping oversee CEO succession.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Executive, board and honorary roles are distinguished; the country field records birthplace and career geography, not proof of dual citizenship.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Morgan Stanley’s shift toward wealth management, helping shape the business model of global investment banking.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned bachelor’s degrees in arts and law from the University of Melbourne and an MBA from Columbia University.
strings.facts.f2.label: Advisory role
strings.facts.f2.value: General Atlantic lists him as a senior advisor; no exact start date is inferred.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Expansion in wealth management
strings.highlights.h1.text: Morgan Stanley completed the E*TRADE acquisition during his CEO tenure, expanding its digital investing services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Board oversight and succession
strings.highlights.h2.text: As Disney chairman and chair of its succession planning committee, he helped oversee the 2026 CEO selection.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Disney CEO succession announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: The board announced its selection of Josh D’Amaro, with a planned March 18 start; Gorman explained the decision as chairman.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Became Disney chairman
strings.timeline.t2.text: After joining the board in 2024, he became chairman, a role distinct from CEO.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Became Morgan Stanley chairman emeritus
strings.timeline.t3.text: His executive chairmanship ended; the honorary title does not confer a board seat.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Served as executive chairman
strings.timeline.t4.text: After stepping down as CEO, he served as Morgan Stanley executive chairman through December that year.
strings.timeline.t5.title: E*TRADE acquisition completed
strings.timeline.t5.text: Morgan Stanley acquired E*TRADE in an all-stock transaction, adding a digital channel for individual investors.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Also became Morgan Stanley chairman
strings.timeline.t6.text: Added the chairmanship to his CEO responsibilities.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Became Morgan Stanley CEO
strings.timeline.t7.text: Began leading the firm, serving through December 2023.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joined Morgan Stanley
strings.timeline.t8.text: Previously worked at Merrill Lynch and McKinsey, having begun his career as a lawyer in Melbourne.
